description: Add a GRID sheet with rows and columns to an existing spreadsheet. This action does not create chart-only or DATA_SOURCE sheets. Use properties to configure the GRID sheet's dimensions, tab color, position, visibility, and text direction. Notes: - Sheet names must be unique; use forceUnique=true to auto-append suffix (_2, _3) if name exists - For tab colors, use EITHER rgbColor OR themeColor, not both - Avoid 'index' when creating sheets in parallel (causes errors)

title.title: Title
title.description: The name for the new sheet tab. Must be unique within the spreadsheet. Example: "Q3 Report", "Sales Data 2025". This is a convenience parameter - alternatively, you can set this via properties.title. Note: sheet_name is also accepted as an alias for title.
title.human_parameter_description: The name for the new sheet tab. Must be unique within the spreadsheet.

properties.title: SheetProperties

index.title: Index
index.description: The zero-based index where the sheet should be inserted. Must be less than or equal to the current number of sheets. If not set, the sheet will be added at the end. Example: 0 for the first position. CONCURRENCY WARNING: Do not use 'index' when creating multiple sheets in parallel - this causes 'index is too high' errors. For parallel creation, omit this field and let sheets be added at the end.
index.human_parameter_description: The position where the new sheet should appear (0 = first). Leave empty to add at the end.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name of the sheet. Must be unique within the spreadsheet. Example: "Q3 Report", "Sales Data 2025"
title.human_parameter_description: The name for the new sheet tab. Must be unique within the spreadsheet.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: True if the sheet is hidden in the UI, false if it's visible.
hidden.human_parameter_description: Set to true to create a hidden sheet, or false/empty for a visible sheet.

sheetId.title: Sheet Id
sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet. If not set, an ID will be randomly generated. Must be non-negative and unique within the spreadsheet. WARNING: Avoid setting this unless you need a specific ID.
sheetId.human_parameter_description: A specific numeric ID for the new sheet. Usually left empty to let Google auto-generate one.

sheetType.title: RequestSheetType
sheetType.description: The only sheet type accepted by GOOGLESHEETS_ADD_SHEET.
sheetType.human_parameter_description: Only GRID sheets with rows and columns are supported.

rightToLeft.title: Right To Left
rightToLeft.description: True if the sheet is an RTL sheet, false if it's LTR.
rightToLeft.human_parameter_description: Set to true for right-to-left language sheets (e.g., Arabic, Hebrew).

red.title: Red

blue.human_parameter_description: The amount of blue in the color (0.0-1.0).

green.title: Green

green.human_parameter_description: The amount of green in the color (0.0-1.0).

force_unique.title: Force Unique
force_unique.description: When True (default), automatically ensures the sheet name is unique by appending a numeric suffix (e.g., '_2', '_3') if the requested name already exists. This makes the action resilient to retries and parallel workflows. When False, the action fails with an error if a sheet with the same name already exists.
force_unique.human_parameter_description: Defaults to True. Automatically appends a suffix (like '_2', '_3') if the sheet name already exists, ensuring the sheet is always created successfully. Set to False to fail if the name already exists.

spreadsheet_id.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheet_id.description: REQUIRED. Cannot be empty. The ID of the target spreadsheet where the new sheet will be added. This is the long alphanumeric string in the Google Sheet URL (e.g., '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'). Use 'Search Spreadsheets' action to find the spreadsheet ID by name if you don't have it.
spreadsheet_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the Google Spreadsheet where you want to add a new sheet. Find this in the spreadsheet URL. Cannot be empty.
